column2: Q & A with Dr. Manijeh Motaghy
Two online Q&A sessions facilitated by Dr. Manijeh Motaghy from Perfectly Here in Los Angeles, California in September 2020. The exact dates are unclear.

My son passed away. It's been about three years now. Thank God to the Dharma, to the Buddha, to the Saṅgha, to the practice ... The pain and suffering of it has reduced dramatically.
